releaseNotes: AURA 3.2.0 is a deep-audit release: BS.1770-4 gated Integrated LUFS and 4x-oversampled True Peak, working MIDI fader recommendations (port: MixSense AI Control), correct 48/96 kHz analysis, Escape closes Deep Field, genre radar always shows your genre, cyan on-target band tints, drag-and-drop Full Track Reports, and many stability fixes.
